Rina: quick poll — low-key evening: instrumental study playlists (lofi/neo-classical) or trashy reality TV? drop recs. I'm deciding between cooking and actually watching something. :popcorn:

Tess: book rec too? short + cozy: 'The Storied Life of A. J. Fikry' — pairs with tea.

DevBot: Poll created — option A: Instrumental, option B: Reality TV. Results: Instrumental 6, Reality TV 2 (after 15m).
